entries.16e28c4c8b227f61: This business manufactures and sells industrial inkjet heads, inks for industrial inkjet printing, and industrial printers that enable a wide range of printing on building materials, furniture, wallpaper, signage displays, apparel fabrics and more.
entries.2aa15b6949b70d63: This category brings together the Smart Vision Business, which digitizes sites in real estate, construction and civil engineering by combining 360-degree cameras with software and cloud services, new businesses addressing social issues, and camera-related businesses such as digital cameras. It also includes environmental and healthcare businesses. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥43,114 million, up 20.3% from ¥35,847 million in the previous year. The company explains that camera-related businesses performed well, centered on the RICOH GR series.
entries.3268fcc3bba26d80: This business supports the transformation of customers' entire workflows and work style reform in three areas: process automation, workplace experience and IT services. The company positions these three as focus areas that free working people from routine tasks, enhance creativity and build the foundation of the workplace.
entries.418ef27fad27f6a1: This business provides digital printing equipment and services to customers who work in printing, and to production sites that print on building materials, furniture, wallpaper, signage displays and apparel fabrics. It has 2 businesses: Commercial Printing and Industrial Printing. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥284,043 million, down 2.9% from ¥292,663 million in the previous year. The company explains that revenue fell because consumables for production printers remained firm, while sales of main units declined as investment was held back, mainly in the United States, due to the impact of tariff policies.
entries.43ba113f9be11631: This business sells imaging equipment such as multifunction devices, printers and scanners, along with consumables, and provides maintenance services to offices worldwide, while also offering office services that change how customers work.
entries.43ed9ab27eea57b7: This business develops and manufactures image equipment such as office multifunction printers, for which the company holds a world-leading share, as well as printers, scanners and edge devices that support digital communication.
entries.4f2e6b3af6e29015: This business provides digital printing products (such as production printers) and services mainly to businesses in the printing industry, enabling short-run printing of many varieties.
entries.8238ab4db07a04c9: This business provides digital printing equipment and services to customers who work in printing, and to production sites that print on building materials, furniture, wallpaper, signage displays and apparel fabrics.
entries.864fba054b8ffa36: This business sells imaging equipment such as multifunction devices, printers and scanners, along with consumables, and provides maintenance services to offices worldwide, while also offering office services that change how customers work. Office services support the transformation of entire workflows and work style reform in three areas: process automation, workplace experience and IT services. The company notes that this segment is limited to the office services business and businesses mainly involving sales of office printing, and does not represent the entire digital services of the company's 'digital services company' concept. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,988,530 million, up 3.0% from ¥1,930,109 million in the previous year, and is the largest business in consolidated revenue of ¥2,608,314 million. IT services and application services grew in Japan, while sales in the Americas declined.
entries.9613c5f5231bcd80: This business sells image equipment for offices, such as multifunction printers, printers and scanners, along with their consumables, and provides maintenance services.
entries.9ecc716a806bf632: This business manufactures and sells automation equipment and inspection equipment for manufacturers, as well as precision components mainly for the automotive industry.
entries.ae39ee350731625f: This business manufactures and sells thermal paper for barcode labels and thermal transfer ribbons used at manufacturing, distribution, logistics and medical sites, as well as labelless thermal products for the functional packaging market.
entries.b3858545d7b5e78d: This business manufactures and sells thermal products, such as thermal paper used at manufacturing, distribution, logistics and medical sites, as well as precision components mainly for the automotive industry and automation equipment and inspection equipment for manufacturers.
entries.bc1578c687944c9f: An office equipment manufacturer based in Ota-ku, Tokyo, that, in addition to selling and maintaining multifunction printers and printers, changes the way work is done in the workplace through IT services.
entries.c066a7da36fb4c18: This business develops and manufactures image equipment such as office multifunction printers, for which the company holds a world-leading share, as well as printers, scanners and edge devices that support digital communication. It also includes OEM production for other companies. The equipment it makes is mainly sold to Digital Services. Intersegment revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 of ¥400,753 million mainly consists of revenue from this flow. External customer revenue was ¥186,395 million, up 18.7% from ¥157,065 million in the previous year. The company explains that sales to Toshiba Tec Corporation and Oki Electric Industry Co., Ltd. through ETORIA Corporation, a joint venture formed with Toshiba Tec Corporation in July 2024, contributed to the increase in revenue. Revenue including intersegment revenue is ¥587,148 million.

The company explains that demand in the Americas continued to decline in logistics, while demand in Japan and Europe was firm.

entries.ed9cabf4fd474438: This business manufactures and sells thermal products, such as thermal paper used at manufacturing, distribution, logistics and medical sites, as well as precision components mainly for the automotive industry and automation equipment and inspection equipment for manufacturers. It has 2 businesses: Thermal Business and Industrial Products Business. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥106,232 million, down 5.3% from ¥112,192 million in the previous year. The company attributes the decline to the impact of the transfer of the Optical Business in the previous fiscal year, and states that excluding this impact, revenue was on a par with the previous year.
